reviews.summary: **Complaints about his family.** Not even as a joke. He'll read it on the day, possibly with them nearby.

dealbreakers: Snow Globe note says "Up to four of your lines appear in the snow ... with photos in between". The code doesn't allow that. revealPlan() in src/templates/snow-globe/storm.ts caps the whole reveal at the number of shakes (at most four), and lines take turns with photos. The manifest needs at least one photo (photos.min = 1), so at most three lines can ever appear in the snow. field-meta.ts says it too: "One thing appears in the snow each time it settles". The Spanish note («Hasta cuatro frases tuyas aparecen en la nieve») has the same error.
